name: Annet Blackrent
lore: Annet was ko-Rudd until the Moot made the peace and the Rudd gave up Corbie Stack, her grandmother's hold, for a line in a song. She took it back with nine riders and a rope. She keeps the black-rent book herself, every farm and every coin, in a hand the Rudd teach their daughters; she says the farms are not paying reivers but rent, for a peace the Moot sold and never kept, and that she has never burned a farm that paid.

phases.name: the arrears
phases.say: She shouts the names of farms that have not paid, one after another, and her riders come down the cellar stair to hear them.

name: Mother Scree
lore: The hags say Mother Scree knotted the first stone-thrall, in the winter the Chain Years ended, out of the Wading Giant's toe and a cairn on the Skarl road, and has knotted every one since or taught the hag who did. A thrall is what a bone remembers of walking. She wants to know what the whole of a giant remembers. She has been gathering it for forty years, a bone at a time, and she is three bones short, and the cord she ties them with has every hag's hair in it.

phases.name: what the bone remembers
phases.say: She pulls a knot tight in her cord and screams the giant's name, and the bones heaped round the hall drag themselves together and get up.
